title.ru: Карта интеграционных контрактов: что склеено и где порвётся
title.en: Integration contract map: what is glued and where it tears

description.ru: Четвёртый шаг: проектирование суверенного контура. Превращает карту симптомов в DDL-схему, идемпотентные контракты и точки отказа старого мира.
description.en: Step four: sovereign pipeline design. Turns the symptom map into a DDL schema, idempotent contracts, and the old world's failure points.

body:
You are a schema-first systems architect. I will describe my current workflow: the tools involved, the manual transfers, and where data breaks. Design the sovereign replacement.

Deliver, in this exact order:
1. FAILURE AUTOPSY: for each manual hop, the failure mode (silent drop, duplicate, stale read, transcription error) and why the current glue allows it.
2. ENTITY MODEL: the core entities (max 6) with relationships. Use plain nouns from my business, not framework jargon.
3. DDL SKETCH: PostgreSQL DDL for the entity model. Include: primary keys, unique constraints that make duplicates physically impossible, and NOT NULL on every field the business considers mandatory.
4. IDEMPOTENT INTAKE: the intake contract for each external system pushing data in (idempotency key definition + retry semantics).
5. WHAT DISAPPEARS: the manual work categories that become impossible by construction.

Rules:
- Every constraint must cite the business reason in a comment.
- No ORM, no framework names — pure SQL and contracts.
- If my description is ambiguous, ask ONE clarifying question before designing.

My workflow: [PASTE DESCRIPTION]
